answer.explanation: Starting with an initial portfolio value of $150,000 at a monthly compounding interest rate of 0.5% (6% nominal annual rate), the portfolio grows under the scheduled cash flows (contributions of $1,000/month for months 1–120, $1,500/month for months 121–240, and a single $30,000 withdrawal at month 180) to a projected month-240 balance of $999,945.734518. Compared to the target of $1,200,000, the shortfall is $200,054.265482. To bridge this gap with an additional fixed end-of-month contribution over all 240 months, the exact monthly amount required is $432.979562, which rounds upward to $432.98 per month.
